text: Handling deadlines well requires good planning and clear thinking. First, time management is essential. Make a schedule and stick to it, setting small goals for each day. Next, prioritization helps you focus on the most important tasks first. Not everything needs to be done at once. Scope management is also important: if a project is too big, reduce it to what is truly necessary. Finally, communication matters. If you realize you cannot finish on time, tell your team or manager early. They may offer help or adjust the deadline. With these skills, you can reduce stress and complete your work successfully.
